item.title: India’s Enterprise ICT Sector Set for 15.5% Growth
item.summary: India’s enterprise information and communications technology (ICT) sector is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 15.5% through 2030. This growth is being driven by an increase in artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, the transition to cloud services, investments in data centers, and advancements in digital infrastructure, reshaping technology expenditures.
